world.mapsThisServerHasPlayed: Maps this server has played before. Switching restarts it.
world.everythingBuiltOnThisMap: Everything built on this map goes with it, and it is not the map the server is playing on. Back it up first if you might want it.
world.leaveBlankForARandom: Leave blank for a random world
world.aNumberOrAnyWords: A number or any words. The same seed always generates the same map.
world.theWholeOverworldIsThis: The whole overworld is this one biome. The Nether and the End are unchanged.
world.inventoriesEnderChestsStatsAnd: Inventories, ender chests, stats and advancements come across. Everyone spawns fresh on the new map.
world.bedrockKeepsPlayerDataInside: Bedrock keeps player data inside the world itself, so a new map always starts everyone over.
world.theServerRestartsToGenerate: The server restarts to generate it, so anybody playing is disconnected. The map it is on now is kept and you can switch back to it.
world.aCopyOfTheWorld: A copy of the world kept on the server's own disk, taken with saving paused so it is not caught mid-write. That covers a mistake, not a dead disk - download the ones that matter.
world.theArchiveGoesTheWorld: The archive goes; the world it was taken from is not touched.
world.copiesAreTakenOnlyWhen: Copies are taken only when you press the button.
world.noLimitOnHowMany: No limit on how many are kept.
world.takenAfterTheServerSaves: Taken after the server saves and before the container goes down, so the copy holds the last thing that happened rather than the last scheduled one.
world.aNotificationWhenAScheduled: A notification when a scheduled copy could not be taken. A server that is simply stopped is skipped quietly.
world.restoreBody: {name} restarts onto the world in this backup, so anybody playing is disconnected. The map it is on now is kept as it is - if this was the wrong backup, switch back to it under World.
world.olderGo: Older ones go once there are more than {count}.
world.budgetHint: Nought is no limit. The oldest go as the total approaches it. The newest copy is never deleted.
world.budgetHintUsed: Nought is no limit. The oldest go as the total approaches it - they take up {size} now. The newest copy is never deleted.

schedule.hoursTheServerIsKept: Hours the server is kept up, and hours it may stop once nobody is playing. Times are read where you say, not where the machine is. Nothing here restarts the server to take effect.
schedule.theZoneTheTimesAre: The zone the times are read in
schedule.minutesWithNobodyPlayingBefore: Minutes with nobody playing before a sleeping window stops it
schedule.usedOnlyByARule: Used only by a rule set to Sleep when empty.
schedule.whileItIsAsleepThe: While it is asleep the server list says so, and a player joining starts it. That attempt of theirs ends straight away - the server is only beginning to load - and joining again a minute later gets them in.
schedule.startThisServerWhenSomebody: Start this server when somebody tries to join it
schedule.whileThisServerIsAsleep: While this server is asleep its port is closed, so nobody can start it by joining. Turn on sharing the port under Address and a player arriving by name starts it again.
schedule.whileThisServerIsAsleep2: While this server is asleep its port is closed and nothing can see somebody trying to reach it, so it is started from here or by a window that says Keep running.
schedule.noWindowsYetSoThe: No windows yet, so the whole week follows the rule above.
schedule.thingsToDoAtA: Things to do at a time: restart it, warn everyone, take a backup, run a command.
schedule.thisIsWhatTheServer: This is what the server follows.
schedule.whatTheServerDoesIn: What the server does in this window
schedule.name: Name

modes.sleepHint: Stopped once nobody has played for a while. It gives its memory back, and somebody trying to join starts it again where that is possible.
modes.offHint: Stopped even if somebody is on.

schedule.quietHint: To have it go quiet without anybody starting it again, leave the schedule off and set <setting>Pause when nobody is playing</setting> under Settings. The server keeps its address, stops using the processor, and comes back the moment somebody joins.

playersTab.arrivedFromAnAddressThe: arrived from an address the log did not carry
playersTab.aHomeConnectionIsGiven: A home connection is given a new address by its provider every so often, and the player is thrown out when it happens. Allowing the new one keeps the old one as well.
playersTab.checkEachPlayerSAddress: Check each player's address when they join
playersTab.bedrockDoesNotRecordWhere: Bedrock does not record where a player connected from, so only the names here are enforced.
playersTab.decidedWhileTheServerOr: Decided while the server or the player was away. Each one runs by itself as soon as it can, and lapses if it never can.
playersTab.theServerHasNotAnswered: The server has not answered for this player yet.
playersTab.onlyPlayersWhoAreOn: Only players who are on the server report a level.
playersTab.hasNotLoggedInSince: Has not logged in since registering
playersTab.setsOneOnTheirNext: Sets one on their next join
playersTab.addressesThePolarisFirewallBlocks: Addresses the Polaris firewall blocks. A game server refuses them only once they are on its own ban list.
playersTab.resetBody: {name} sets a new one the next time they join.
playersTab.closedHintJava: The server is closed until somebody is registered. Add yourself first: your Minecraft username, and the address you play from - the locate button fills in the one you are on now.
playersTab.closedHintBedrock: The server is closed until somebody is registered. Add yourself first: your gamertag, and the address you play from - the locate button fills in the one you are on now.
playersTab.whoCanJoinHint: A player is let in when the username is on this list and they arrive from the address registered to it.
playersTab.unlinkBodyAddresses: {name} stops following a Polaris account. The addresses that came from its sign-ins go with it, which takes {name} off the list.
playersTab.unlinkBody: {name} stops following a Polaris account and comes off the list.
playersTab.linkedHint: Joins from wherever {name} is signed in to Polaris
playersTab.idle: {name} has not moved or turned for {minutes} minutes
playersTab.rangesBlocked: {count} {count, plural, one {range is} other {ranges are}} blocked in the firewall. Minecraft bans single addresses only, so those are not applied here.
playersTab.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, address or note
playersTab.nobodyAtAll: Nobody is registered and nobody is playing.
playersTab.killBody: They die where they stand and drop what they were carrying. Nothing stops them respawning.
playersTab.allBanned: Every blocked address was already banned here
playersTab.bannedCount: Banned {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}}

xray.everythingRecordedAgainstThemIs: Everything recorded against them is forgotten, as if it never happened.
xray.aroundEveryPlayerWhereverThey: Around every player, wherever they are. Between 4 and 40.
xray.ancientDebrisInTheNether: Ancient debris in the Nether too
xray.hideAncientDebrisInThe: Hide ancient debris in the Nether
xray.whatHappensWhenSomebodyIs: What happens when somebody is confirmed
xray.inTheChatWithA: In the chat, with a title. Colour codes such as &c work.
xray.flagsAPlayerSeenHovering: Flags a player seen hovering without being allowed to fly, or moving further in a few seconds than anybody can, when no operator teleported them. Operators, creative mode, elytras, vehicles and portals are left out. Never acted on automatically: an ender pearl stasis chamber can look like a teleport.
xray.changesApplyToTheRunning: Changes apply to the running server, with no restart.
xray.onlySomebodyWhoManagesThis: Only somebody who manages this server can change it.
xray.howLikelyEachPlayerIs: How likely each player is cheating
xray.fromWhatWasFoundIn: From what was found in the last 14 days. Only honeypots can confirm X-Ray; the mining rate is context and on its own never goes past Unlikely. The anti-cheat column is Polaris anti-cheat's alerts, which count once a check has failed past its own threshold. Everybody online is listed. Mining counts are the game's own and arrive when the server saves, a few minutes behind.
xray.whereAndWhenNewestFirst: Where and when, newest first, so you can go and look before deciding.

actions.notify: Tell me, and do nothing else
actions.warn: Tell me and warn the player
actions.ban: Tell me, warn, and ban if it goes on

xray.intro: Polaris hides single diamonds and ancient debris fully enclosed in rock around the players. Nobody can see them without X-Ray, so digging straight to {count} of them confirms it. One on its own could be chance.
xray.atLeast: At least {count}, and only after the warning.
xray.hiddenNow: {diamonds} diamonds and {debris} debris hidden right now. Changes apply without a restart.

reasons.hits: Dug straight to {count} ores hidden in solid rock
reasons.oneHit: Dug to 1 ore hidden in solid rock - one can be chance
reasons.rateDiamond: Mines 1 diamond per {per} deepslate - fast, though exploring caves does that too
reasons.rateDebris: Mines 1 ancient debris per {per} nether rock - fast, though exploring caves does that too
reasons.flights: Hovered in the air {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} without being allowed to fly
reasons.teleports: Moved further than anybody can {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}}, with no command explaining it

checks.FarPlace: placed a block it could not reach

xray.savedPlaced: Saved. Honeypots are placed around the players within a minute. No restart needed.
xray.savedPlacedWatched: Saved. Honeypots are placed around the players within a minute, and players are watched from the next few seconds. No restart needed.
xray.savedRemovedWatched: Saved. Honeypots are being turned back into rock, and players are watched from the next few seconds. No restart needed.
xray.savedOff: Off. The honeypots are being turned back into rock. No restart needed.
xray.playersFailed: The players could not be read.
xray.nothingRecorded: Nothing recorded against anybody yet, and no mining figures to show.
xray.noIncidents: Nothing has happened in the last 14 days.
xray.incidentsFailed: The incidents could not be read.

access.reachNote: The port stays open to anyone who can reach it, so a stranger can still see this server in their list and read its description. What the list refuses is the login: an unregistered name, or a registered one arriving from somewhere else, does not get in.

mods.itComesOffTheList: It comes off the list now. The server uninstalls it when you save and restart.
mods.bedrockServersDoNotLoad: Bedrock servers do not load mods or plugins.
mods.changeTheServerSoftwareUnder: Change the server software under Settings to Paper for plugins, or Fabric, Forge or NeoForge for mods.
mods.thisIsNotWhatModrinth: This is not what Modrinth has - the search did not go through.
mods.changesApplyOnTheNext: Changes apply on the next restart.
mods.theServerInstallsTheseWhen: The server installs these when it boots and removes whatever is taken off.
mods.whichDependenciesToInstallWith: Which dependencies to install with a mod
mods.itIsInstalledAndIt: It is installed and it is not running. Whatever it was installed for is not in the game until this is fixed.
mods.nothingInstalledYetBrowseBelow: Nothing installed yet. Browse below to add a mod or plugin.
mods.modrinthHasNoProjectBy: Modrinth has no project by this name
mods.cannotLoad: This server runs {software}, which cannot load mods.
mods.onlyFor: Only what runs on {loader} and has a build for {version}.

mods.nothingForVersion: Nothing on Modrinth runs on {loader} with a build for {version}.
mods.serverSideOnly: Only mods that run on a server are listed, so a client-only one - a HUD, a minimap, a shader - is missing because it is installed in your own game rather than on this server.
mods.blocking: {name} needs {needs}, which has no build for this server. Take it off the list, or the server will restart until it is stopped.
mods.cannotInstall: {name} cannot be installed on this server
mods.refused: The server would not load {count, plural, one {one of these} other {# of these}} when it last started
mods.noReason: the server did not say why.
mods.clashTitle: Its publisher says it cannot run alongside {names}
mods.needsAdd: {name} needs {needs}. Add it to the list.
mods.needsNoBuildTitle: {needs} has no build for this server, and {name} will not start without it
mods.needsNoBuild: needs {name}, which has no build here
mods.playersWillDrop: {count, plural, one {# player is} other {# players are}} connected and will be disconnected.
mods.restartsToInstall: The server restarts to install and remove what changed.

inventoryEditor.everythingTheyCarryGoesArmour: Everything they carry goes, armour and offhand included. This cannot be undone.
inventoryEditor.everythingTheyCarryGoesWhen: Everything they carry goes when they next join, armour and offhand included. This cannot be undone.
inventoryEditor.dragAStackAnywhereBag: Drag a stack anywhere: bag, hotbar, worn or offhand. Onto the same item it stacks up. Hold Ctrl to move one of it, and right-click to split it in half.
inventoryEditor.dragAnItemFromThe: Drag an item from the palette onto the slot it should land in.
inventoryEditor.saveItForTheirNext: Save it for their next join
inventoryEditor.dropAStackHereTo: Drop a stack here to take it away
inventoryEditor.nobodyElseIsOnThe: Nobody else is on the server to send to.
inventoryEditor.chooseAPlayerThenDrop: Choose a player, then drop a stack here
inventoryEditor.sendAllBody: Every stack {from} carries moves to {to}, a stack at a time. What does not fit in {to}'s bag lands at their feet.
inventoryEditor.sent: Sent {count, plural, one {# stack} other {# stacks}} to {to}.
inventoryEditor.lastCopyNote: This is the last copy Polaris kept. Nothing in it can be moved, but an item dropped onto a slot is saved and given to them when they join.
inventoryEditor.noCopyNote: Polaris has no copy of their bag yet - one is kept every ten minutes while they play - so it is drawn empty. Nothing can be moved out of it, but an item dropped onto a slot is saved and given to them when they join.
inventoryEditor.unreadable: {count, plural, one {# stack was} other {# stacks were}} too large for the server to hand over in one reply, so {count, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} not drawn here.
inventoryEditor.stuck: {count, plural, one {# stack carries} other {# stacks carry}} data Polaris cannot write back exactly, so {count, plural, one {it cannot} other {they cannot}} be moved without losing it.
inventoryEditor.manyStacks: {count} stacks. One lands where you drop it and the rest go into the bag.
inventoryEditor.orDrag: Or drag it onto a slot.
inventoryEditor.orDragToSave: Or drag it onto a slot to save it for their next join.
inventoryEditor.dropToSend: Drop a stack here to send it to {name}

ago.hours: {count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} ago
ago.days: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago

inventoryEditor.noFreeSlot: There is no free slot to split it into.

inventory.summary: {total, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in {stacks, plural, one {# stack} other {# stacks}}.
inventory.waiting: {count, plural, one {# stack is} other {# stacks are}} waiting for them to join.

sidebar.aBoxOnTheRight: A box on the right of every player's screen. Polaris keeps its values current while the server runs.
sidebar.title: Title
sidebar.dragToMoveOrUse: Drag to move, or use the arrow keys
sidebar.onlySomebodyWhoManagesThis: Only somebody who manages this server can change it.
sidebar.twoLinesThatShowEach: Two lines that show each of these in turn: its heading, and the list under it. Shift-click takes a whole stretch, Ctrl+A all of them.
sidebar.thePanelHasNoRoom: The panel has no room for two more lines. Remove one first.
sidebar.offNobodySeesItUntil: Off: nobody sees it until it is switched on.
